title: Jsc2026m000939 Go Flight Mike Lammers SOCIAL
description: NASA flight director Mike Lammers began his career at Johnson Space Center as a crew instructor and then an attitude determination and control officer supporting the International Space Station. As a flight controller, he was responsible for the orientation and motion control systems of station. He spent many years working alongside flight directors and was inspired to pursue the opportunity as the next step in his career path. In his role, Lammers is responsible for the big picture, aligning teams of flight controllers to meet goals and address challenges quickly and effectively. He has been a flight director for more than 15 years, and appreciates the dynamic nature of his work. From crew and cargo launches and overseeing spacewalks to supporting daily operations aboard the space station, every day has something unique in store for him. Learn more about the role of the flight director at nasa.gov/flight-director-faq/
